question: Will Arsenal FC sign an additional new defender before the 2026 summer transfer window closes?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Arsenal FC officially complete the signing of at least one additional defender (on a permanent transfer or loan) before the 2026 summer transfer window closes at 23:00 BST on 1 September 2026, as confirmed by an official announcement from Arsenal FC or registration confirmed by the Premier League.
- "No": Wins if Arsenal FC do not complete the signing of any additional defender before the 2026 summer transfer window closes at 23:00 BST on 1 September 2026.

Clarifications:
- "Additional" means any defender signed after the market's creation date (2026-08-18). A defender is any player whose primary listed position is centre-back, full-back, or wing-back as described in the official signing announcement or squad registration.
- Both permanent transfers and loan signings count. Free-agent signings completed before the window closes also count.
